readme: 'Dashboard Feature Squad – Test cases to update and retest after Chris's answers (14 Oct 2026)

'Chris Ward has now answered every open question on the Dashboard, and the spec has been updated (version 46, 14 Oct). We checked every Dashboard test case against it. The test cases below were last updated in TestRail by you, so we have not changed them: this sheet lists the behaviour that changed in each, what it was before and what it is now, so they can be updated and run again. The test cases we last updated ourselves have been updated in TestRail separately.
'Only real behaviour changes are listed: in each case, a tester following it today would either fail a correct build or pass a wrong one. Word-only changes are left out.
'What changed in the spec since 7 Oct

'13 Oct (v44): the table under an expanded chart follows the Technician or Advisor filter, and hides with the chart when every technician is unticked. 14 Oct (v45, after Chris's answers): among others, the At Risk panel has no "Inactive for" box of its own; the At Risk line at zero reads "$0.00 (12mo) · 0 customers"; the expanded Revenue chart follows the tile's date range (daily bars on This Month); legend hover shows no average; a tile's custom range is at most 366 days.
'One line of C351708 waits on Chris (question 16 on his sheet): what the expanded Revenue chart shows when a location has no sales at all.

'The test case itself is still correct: Chris confirmed the 12-month revenue link on 14 Oct. Please check only the automated script: if step 2 changes the inactivity window with an "Inactive for" box inside the At Risk panel, change it to use the pill on the At Risk Customers tile.

'Since 14 Oct the spec says the At Risk panel has no inactivity control of its own; the pill on the tile is the only one (rule S5-N3, version 45). A correct build will no longer have the panel box, so a script that uses it will break.
